description: Name towns, kingdoms, and taverns — three place modes with original syllable banks for fantasy maps and stories.

faqs.a: Towns use English-style roots (Oakford, Thornbury), kingdoms use majestic endings (Aldoria), taverns use “The” + adjective + noun.
faqs.q: How do the three modes differ?

faqs.a: All names are original syllable combinations — original place names for your maps, games, and stories.
faqs.q: Are these copied from fantasy books?

faqs.a: Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Pick town, kingdom, or tavern mode.
Choose how many names to generate.
Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.
title: Place Name Generator
